scenes.title: Stock Index Futures & Program Trading
scenes.purpose: Explain how index arbitrage and automated program trading replicate constituent stock baskets
takeaways: Index futures compound spot at net carry rate (r - q)
Index arbitrage swaps futures against weighted constituent baskets
Program trading routes 500 stock orders within milliseconds

body.text: Arbitrageurs trade weighted shares of all 500 companies simultaneously.
Execution engines fire simultaneous market orders in milliseconds.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Stock index futures follow our continuous yield formula F zero equals S zero exp(r minus q times T), aggregating index dividends smoothly.

hi.display: स्टॉक इंडेक्स फ्यूचर्स हमारे फॉर्मूले एफ जीरो बराबर एस जीरो ई की पावर आर माइनस क्यू टी पर चलते हैं, जहां क्यू कुल डिविडेंड यील्ड है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Connect Part 1 continuous yield formula to index futures

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: When index quotes drift apart, desks launch index arbitrage, which means trading index futures against weighted baskets of all 500 stocks.

hi.display: जब इंडेक्स कोट भटकते हैं, तो डेस्क इंडेक्स आर्बिट्राज करते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है फ्यूचर्स के साथ 500 शेयरों के बास्केट का एक साथ व्यापार करना।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define index arbitrage on 500-stock basket

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Humans cannot route 500 tickets fast enough. Instead, firms deploy program trading, which means computerized order engines hitting every stock simultaneously.

hi.display: इंसान 500 ऑर्डर इतनी तेजी से नहीं लगा सकते। इसके लिए कंपनियां प्रोग्राम ट्रेडिंग का इस्तेमाल करती हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कंप्यूटर द्वारा एक साथ सभी शेयर ट्रेड करना।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define program trading millisecond execution

scenes.title: Arbitrage Bands, FX Myths & Triple Witching
scenes.purpose: Contrast frictionless textbook myths with arbitrage bands and quarterly expiration surges
takeaways: Commissions and spreads carve a no-trade arbitrage band
Triple Witching quarterly unwinds spark sudden expiration volume
High-rate foreign currencies trade at forward discounts, not premiums

left.heading: Friction & Arbitrage Band
points: Broker fees and bid-ask spreads create an arbitrage band
Tiny deviations inside the band cost more than they pay
Triple Witching quarterly expirations unwind massive baskets

right.heading: Novice Trap vs Currency Reality
points: Myth: Higher foreign interest lifts the forward currency quote
Reality: Arbitrage forces high-yield currency to trade at a discount
Lower forward exchange rate cancels extra foreign interest

verdict.text: Arbitrage fires only beyond the band, and currency forwards offset interest spreads.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Real markets are not zero-fee. Commissions and spreads form an arbitrage band, which means a narrow zone around fair value where trading loses money.

hi.display: असली बाजार बिना शुल्क के नहीं होते। कमीशन और स्प्रेड एक आर्बिट्राज बैंड बनाते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है सही मूल्य के आसपास वह दायरा जहां ट्रेडिंग घाटे का सौदा है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define arbitrage band caused by trading costs

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Beyond the band, program orders flood exchanges, especially during quarterly Triple Witching Hour expirations when huge arbitrage baskets unwind together.

hi.display: बैंड से बाहर निकलते ही प्रोग्राम ऑर्डर बाढ़ ला देते हैं, खासकर तिमाही ट्रिपल विचिंग आवर पर जब बड़े बास्केट एक साथ अनवाइंड होते हैं।

beats.onScreenIntent: Highlight Triple Witching expiration volume surges

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Avoid the currency trap too: higher foreign rates do not lift currency forwards higher. Arbitrage forces high-interest currencies to a forward discount.

hi.display: विदेशी मुद्रा के भ्रम से भी बचें: ऊंची विदेशी ब्याज दरें फॉरवर्ड कोट को ऊपर नहीं धकेलतीं, बल्कि ऊंचे ब्याज वाली मुद्रा को फॉरवर्ड डिस्काउंट पर लाती हैं।

beats.onScreenIntent: Reveal misconception verdict on FX forward discount

scenes.title: Currency Forwards: Covered Interest Parity
scenes.purpose: Derive Covered Interest Parity by modeling foreign interest rf as continuous dividend yield
takeaways: Foreign interest rate rf behaves exactly like dividend yield q
Covered Interest Parity sets F0 = S0 exp((r - rf) * T)
Premium or discount depends directly on domestic minus foreign rate

data.title: Covered Interest Parity (CIP)

parts.meaning: Foreign risk-free interest earned smoothly like yield q
Interest rate spread governing forward premium or discount

data.note: Foreign cash earns foreign risk-free rate rf, acting mathematically like dividend yield q.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Hold foreign cash in London or Tokyo, and it earns the foreign risk-free interest rate rf continuously, behaving just like a dividend yield.

hi.display: लंदन या टोक्यो में रखी विदेशी मुद्रा लगातार विदेशी रिस्क-फ्री दर आरएफ कमाती है, जो बिल्कुल डिविडेंड यील्ड की तरह काम करती है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Model foreign currency interest rf as continuous yield

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Replacing q with rf produces Covered Interest Parity, which means currency forward rates strictly mirror the domestic minus foreign interest rate spread.

hi.display: क्यू की जगह आरएफ रखने से कवर्ड इंटरेस्ट पैरिटी बनता है, जिसका अर्थ है करेंसी फॉरवर्ड दरें घरेलू और विदेशी ब्याज अंतर के बराबर रहती हैं।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define Covered Interest Parity formula and spread

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: When domestic interest r beats foreign rate rf, the foreign currency trades at a premium; when foreign rf exceeds r, it trades at a discount.

hi.display: जब घरेलू दर आर विदेशी दर आरएफ से अधिक हो, तो विदेशी मुद्रा प्रीमियम पर ट्रेड करती है; अन्यथा वह डिस्काउंट पर ट्रेड करती है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Explain forward premium and discount regimes

scenes.title: Covered Interest Arbitrage Mechanics
scenes.purpose: Trace the causal chain enforcing Covered Interest Parity across global money markets
takeaways: Parity breaks trigger instant riskless cross-currency trades
Forward FX hedge eliminates all currency exchange uncertainty
Borrowing, converting, investing, and hedging seal guaranteed spread

links.text: FX forward quote strays above parity F0 = S0 exp((r - rf)T)
Bank borrows domestic cash at r and buys foreign spot currency at S0
Foreign bills earn rate rf while future proceeds sell forward at high F0
Forward settlement converts matured foreign funds back into domestic currency
Domestic loan repays in full, leaving zero currency risk and pure profit

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Whenever currency quotes violate parity, desks fire covered interest arbitrage, which means borrowing one currency, converting spot, investing abroad, and hedging forward.

hi.display: जब करेंसी कोट पैरिटी तोड़ते हैं, तो डेस्क कवर्ड इंटरेस्ट आर्बिट्राज करते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है एक मुद्रा उधार लेकर दूसरी में निवेश करना और फॉरवर्ड हेज लगाना।

beats.onScreenIntent: Trigger condition and define covered interest arbitrage

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: While foreign treasury bills earn rf, locking the forward sale price today completely removes any exchange rate fluctuation risk.

hi.display: विदेशी बिल पर आरएफ ब्याज कमाते हुए आज ही फॉरवर्ड बिक्री मूल्य लॉक करने से करेंसी उतार-चढ़ाव का सारा जोखिम खत्म हो जाता है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Lock forward conversion eliminating currency exposure

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: At delivery, converted domestic funds exceed the initial loan repayment, locking riskless spread and snapping currency quotes right back to parity.

hi.display: डिलीवरी पर कनवर्ट की गई घरेलू राशि शुरुआती लोन से अधिक होती है, जिससे बिना जोखिम मुनाफा मिलता है और कोट तुरंत पैरिटी पर लौट आता है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Repay domestic loan and close arbitrage spread

scenes.title: Worked Example: USD/GBP Forward Discount
scenes.purpose: Solve textbook numerical example calculating 1-year USD/GBP forward rate at 1.4557
takeaways: Spot USD/GBP 1.5000 with US 5.0% and UK 8.0% creates -3.0% spread
Continuous carry factor exp(-0.03) gives forward discount 1.4557
Higher UK yield exactly offsets the cheaper forward pound conversion

data.title: Covered Interest Parity: 1-Year USD/GBP Forward
data.conclusion: Because UK rates exceed US rates, the pound trades at a forward discount of 1.4557 $/GBP.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us price a currency forward directly. Spot exchange trades at 1.5000 dollars per British pound, US rates sit at 5.0%, and UK rates pay 8.0% for 1 year.

hi.display: आइए एक करेंसी फॉरवर्ड की गणना करें। स्पॉट दर 1.5000 डॉलर प्रति पाउंड है, अमेरिकी दर 5.0% है और यूके दर 1 वर्ष के लिए 8.0% है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Display spot S0=1.5000, r=5.0%, rf=8.0%, T=1

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Compute rate spread r minus rf first: UK rate 8.0% minus US 5.0% makes spread negative. Will the forward pound trade at a premium or discount?

hi.display: पहले ब्याज दर अंतर आर माइनस आरएफ निकालें: यूके दर 8.0% अमेरिकी 5.0% से ज्यादा है, तो क्या फॉरवर्ड पाउंड प्रीमियम पर होगा या डिस्काउंट पर?

beats.onScreenIntent: Prediction prompt on rate spread r - rf = -0.03

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: A discount. Multiplying 1.5000 by e to the minus 0.03 yields 1.4557 dollars per pound, neutralizing the extra 3% British interest.

hi.display: डिस्काउंट पर। 1.5000 को ई की पावर माइनस 0.03 से गुणा करने पर 1.4557 डॉलर प्रति पाउंड आता है, जो अतिरिक्त 3% यूके ब्याज को बराबर कर देता है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Reveal result 1.4557 dollars per GBP

scenes.title: Commodities: Storage Costs & Convenience Yield
scenes.purpose: Derive commodity carry adding storage u and subtracting physical convenience yield y
takeaways: Storage costs u lift investment metal futures like a negative dividend
Convenience yield y credits operational security of physical stock
Short-sale barriers leave consumption goods with only an upper bound

data.title: Consumption Commodity Futures Pricing

parts.meaning: Vault storage and insurance outlays acting like a negative dividend
Operational security value gained from holding physical inventory
Upper no-arbitrage bound when physical shorting fails

data.note: Storage pushes futures prices up while operational convenience yield pulls them down.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Turning to commodities, holding gold or silver incurs storage costs, which means vault warehousing and insurance expenses u added directly onto financing rate r.

hi.display: कमोडिटीज में सोना या चांदी रखने पर स्टोरेज कॉस्ट लगती है, जिसका अर्थ है गोदाम और बीमा खर्च यू जिसे फाइनेंसिंग दर आर में जोड़ा जाता है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define storage costs u as negative dividend

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Alongside vault storage outlays u, firms holding oil or copper earn convenience yield, which means the operational security benefit y of keeping physical inventory.

hi.display: गोदाम स्टोरेज खर्च यू के साथ तेल या तांबे में कंपनियों को कन्वीनिएंस यील्ड मिलता है, जिसका अर्थ है सप्लाई की कमी के समय भौतिक स्टॉक पास रखने का परिचालन लाभ वाई।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define convenience yield y on consumption goods

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Because refineries cannot easily short oil barrels in storage, futures obey only an upper bound below compounded storage cost r plus u.

hi.display: क्योंकि रिफाइनरी भंडारित तेल के बैरल आसानी से शॉर्ट नहीं कर सकतीं, इसलिए फ्यूचर्स केवल आर प्लस यू की ऊपरी सीमा का पालन करते हैं।

beats.onScreenIntent: Highlight upper bound F0 <= S0 exp((r + u)T)

scenes.title: Unified Cost of Carry Architecture
scenes.purpose: Synthesize all asset classes inside Hull's single Cost of Carry equation
takeaways: Every asset follows one master equation: F0 = S0 exp(cT)
Cost of carry c summarizes financing minus yield plus storage
Global trading desks map all markets onto this unified parameter c

cells: Financing less continuous dividend yield q
Domestic rate less foreign interest rf
Financing plus vault storage cost u
Storage less physical convenience yield y

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: John Hull unites non-income stocks, equity indexes, and every market inside one equation: F zero equals S zero exp(cT), where continuous financing and yield define cost of carry c.

hi.display: जॉन हल नॉन-इनकम स्टॉक, इक्विटी इंडेक्स और सभी बाजारों को एक समीकरण में समेटते हैं: एफ जीरो बराबर एस जीरो ई की पावर सीटी, जिसे नेट कॉस्ट ऑफ कैरी सी चलाती है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Introduce unified table for F0 = S0 exp(cT)

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: For zero-income stocks c equals r, for equity indices c equals r minus q, and for global currencies c equals r minus rf.

hi.display: बिना आय वाले शेयरों के लिए सी बराबर आर, इंडेक्स के लिए आर माइनस क्यू और विदेशी मुद्राओं के लिए आर माइनस आरएफ होता है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Map stocks, indices, and foreign exchange carry c

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Physical metals add storage cost u, while industrial commodities subtract convenience yield y. One unified carry architecture powers every global desk.

hi.display: धातुओं में स्टोरेज खर्च यू जुड़ता है, जबकि औद्योगिक कमोडिटीज में कन्वीनिएंस यील्ड वाई घटता है। यह एकीकृत ढांचा हर ग्लोबल डेस्क चलाता है।

beats.onScreenIntent: Highlight metal and commodity carry rows

scenes.title: Contango, Backwardation & Delivery Options
scenes.purpose: Contrast upward contango carry forces against downward backwardation and short delivery options
takeaways: Contango curves trade above spot when interest and storage dominate
Normal backwardation discounts futures when hedgers pay risk premiums
Delivery options let shorts choose timing, warehouse, and cheapest grade

left.label: Contango Carry Forces
points: Futures trade above spot (positive net carry c)
Financing interest r and storage cost u dominate
Long rollovers pay carrying charges each month

right.label: Backwardation & Short Options
points: High convenience yield y pulls futures below spot
Hedger selling pressure creates Normal Backwardation
Short delivery options depress futures quotes slightly

resolution.label: Curve Equilibrium
resolution.text: Carrying costs lift curves into contango; scarcity and short delivery privileges pull them down.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Every commodity forward curve reflects a tug of war. Contango means futures prices trade above current spot prices because financing and storage dominate.

hi.display: हर कमोडिटी कर्व दो ताकतों के बीच खींचतान दिखाता है। कॉन्टैंगो का अर्थ है जब ब्याज और स्टोरेज खर्च हावी होने से फ्यूचर्स दाम स्पॉट से ऊपर रहते हैं।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define contango on left tug-of-war side

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Conversely, tight supply yields and hedger selling create normal backwardation below spot, reinforced by delivery options, which means short-seller rights over timing, location, and cheapest grade.

hi.display: इसके विपरीत, सप्लाई संकट और हेजर्स की बिक्री नॉर्मल बैकवर्डेशन बनाती है, जिसे डिलीवरी ऑप्शंस मजबूत करते हैं जिनका अर्थ है शॉर्ट विक्रेता के समय, स्थान और ग्रेड चुनने के अधिकार।

beats.onScreenIntent: Define delivery options and backwardation on right panel

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Because exchange delivery options favor the short seller, buyers demand slightly lower futures prices relative to custom forwards.

hi.display: क्योंकि एक्सचेंज के डिलीवरी ऑप्शंस शॉर्ट विक्रेता के पक्ष में होते हैं, खरीदार कस्टम फॉरवर्ड की तुलना में फ्यूचर्स पर थोड़ी कम कीमत मांगते हैं।

beats.onScreenIntent: Reveal equilibrium resolution panel

scenes.title: Active Recall: EUR/USD Covered Interest Parity
scenes.purpose: 3-beat interactive quiz solving 1-year EUR/USD forward premium 1.2753
takeaways: Spot 1.2500 with US 6.0% and Eurozone 4.0% yields +2.0% carry
Positive domestic spread lifts forward quote to 1.2753 USD/EUR
Lower foreign interest earns a compensating forward currency premium

data.question: Spot euro trades at $1.2500 per euro. Continuous US risk-free rate is 6.0% and Eurozone rate is 4.0%. What is the 1-year forward exchange rate?
options: 1.2252 dollars/euro: The euro trades at a forward discount due to lower European interest rates.
1.2753 dollars/euro: The euro trades at a forward premium because US rate exceeds Eurozone rate.
1.2500 dollars/euro: Spot and forward exchange rates match under zero arbitrage.
1.3100 dollars/euro: Both interest rates add together to determine forward currency growth.
data.explanation: By Covered Interest Parity, F0 = 1.2500 * exp((0.06 - 0.04) * 1) = 1.2500 * exp(0.02) = 1.2753 dollars per euro. Because US rate (6.0%) exceeds Eurozone rate (4.0%), the euro trades at a forward premium.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Now apply Covered Interest Parity yourself. Spot euro trades at 1.2500 dollars per euro, US rates pay 6.0%, and Eurozone rates pay 4.0%. Find the 1-year forward rate.

hi.display: अब स्वयं कवर्ड इंटरेस्ट पैरिटी लागू करें। स्पॉट यूरो 1.2500 डॉलर प्रति यूरो है, अमेरिकी दर 6.0% और यूरोजोन दर 4.0% है। 1-वर्ष की फॉरवर्ड दर निकालें।

beats.onScreenIntent: Present euro/dollar quiz parameters

scenes.purpose: Fixed 6-beat summary thread consolidating all 8 macro forward pricing principles from Part 2
takeaways: Program trading keeps index futures within transaction bands

data.title: Eight Essential Rules of Global Forward Pricing

rules.title: Rule 1: Index Arbitrage Baskets
rules.text: Index arbitrage pairs stock index futures against 500-stock equity baskets simultaneously.

rules.title: Rule 2: Friction Arbitrage Bands
rules.text: Execution spreads create arbitrage bands; quarterly unwinds amplify Triple Witching volatility.

rules.title: Rule 3: Covered Interest Parity
rules.text: Foreign currencies follow F0 = S0 exp((r - rf)T), treating foreign yield rf like a dividend.

rules.title: Rule 4: High-Yield FX Discount
rules.text: When foreign interest rate rf exceeds domestic rate r, the foreign forward trades at a discount.

rules.title: Rule 5: Commodity Storage Cost u
rules.text: Warehousing and insurance act like a negative dividend, lifting metal carry to r plus u.

rules.title: Rule 6: Operational Convenience Yield
rules.text: Convenience yield y lowers consumption futures and leaves only an upper pricing bound.

rules.title: Rule 7: Unified Cost of Carry c
rules.text: Every asset conforms to F0 = S0 exp(cT) by mapping c to carry, yield, and storage.

rules.title: Rule 8: Contango vs Delivery Edge
rules.text: Carry builds contango curves while backwardation and short delivery options pull prices lower.

en.display: Let us summarize all eight macro forward pricing rules from Chapter 5 Part 2 before moving onward to Interest Rate Futures.

en.display: Rule 1 executes index arbitrage across 500-stock baskets via program trading. Rule 2 recognizes transaction arbitrage bands and Triple Witching unwind spikes.
